launcher.notes: FORGE OPTIFINE 1.8.9 — YOUR FORGE, OUR JAR. The hand-modified forge jars kept feeling bugged, so the forge jar is now exactly the classic combined ForgeOptiFine 1.8.9: Forge 11.15.1.2318 + OptiFine HD U M5 in ONE jar and NOTHING else (no FoamFix, no FPS boost, no custom loading screen — every file byte-identical to the official jars, merged with the same rules a normal 'OptiFine in mods' install uses; the earlier merge's wrong class-collision choice was the most plausible cause of the broken chunks and changed animations). The launcher detects OptiFine inside the jar automatically and launches with the stock Forge-first/OptiFine-second tweak order, and it pins the six OptiFine render-path options (Smooth World, Lazy Chunk Loading, Fast Render, Smooth FPS, Render Regions, Dynamic Chunk Updates) back to vanilla behavior in optionsof.txt because those cause exactly the 'chunks not loading / animations changed' symptoms on weaker PCs — re-enable any of them in Video Settings; zoom, CTM, HD textures and shaders are untouched. The old Ultra Forge jar is replaced in place, never deleted first. Boot-verified in a real world: chunks generate and render (terrain, water, sky, clouds, entities) with OptiFine active.

notes: Client 3.3.8 "Mirror": the cosmetics update. Scrolling no longer wrecks the cosmetics menu (grid layout root cause fixed); Capes tab shows every real cape including the animated ones; Pets show the REAL pets with their REAL names; Auras render the real ore ring / animated glows and the Spark/Storm name mix-up is fixed. The hub now uses the module menu window proportions (no more near-fullscreen). New "Customize Cosmetics" button on the pause screen for in-world/server customization. Remember-me keeps you signed in between launches and a logout button sits top-right. Launcher 2.7.3 (next) bundles it.

forge.notes: Kinetrix ForgeOptiFine 1.8.9 (Ultra Forge 7): Forge 11.15.1.2318 + OptiFine HD U M5, byte-pure official pair — nothing else. Replaces ultra6/ultra5 in mods/ automatically (size + sha256 verified, in place). Hosted on the launcher release assets.
